name: Researchers
blurb: Scientists whose work moves the field, with citations and h-index.

members.hook: Turing supplied both of AI's founding documents: the 1936 paper proving one universal machine could compute anything computable, and the 1950 paper asking whether machines can think. The first made computers possible; the second made artificial intelligence a research question rather than a fantasy.
members.name: Alan Turing
members.moniker: Father of Theoretical Computer Science and AI

members.hook: Zhavoronkov built Insilico Medicine to prove that generative AI could do more than analyze biology, it could design new drug candidates outright, and Rentosertib, discovered and designed by Insilico's AI pipeline, became one of the first such molecules to reach human clinical trials.
members.name: Alex Zhavoronkov

members.hook: Ng did more than any single figure to turn machine learning from a graduate-school subject into a skill anyone could learn online, while simultaneously building the industrial-scale infrastructure, Google Brain among it, that made deep learning practical at big-tech scale.
members.name: Andrew Ng
members.moniker: AI Educator and Deep Learning Pioneer

members.hook: Rabinovich arrived at the Longuet-Higgins Prize, the computer vision field's highest honor for work that has stood the test of time, the same year his startup was acquired and he became CTO of a public company. His arc from Google research to Magic Leap's human-centered AR, to founding an AI meeting tool, to leading AI at one of the world's largest freelance platforms is a compressed version of the field's own evolution: from perception research to multimodal generation to enterprise deployment.
members.name: Andrew Rabinovich
members.moniker: CTO and Head of AI at Upwork

members.hook: Sengupta has built enterprise AI functions from scratch at four different organizations, AXA XL, Zebra Technologies, and now JPMorgan Chase, while maintaining an active academic research career that produced over 9,100 citations and a co-authored analysis of the EU AI Act, a rare combination of frontier research credentials and boardroom-level AI deployment experience.
members.name: Biswa Sengupta
members.moniker: Chief AI Technologist and Architect of JPMorgan's LLM Suite

members.hook: Nguyen holds a Stanford PhD combining AI with bioengineering and spent years on deepfake detection at Facebook AI and Adobe before research internships in Fei-Fei Li's and Leonidas Guibas's labs and at Google DeepMind's co-scientist team. He now leads Radical Numerics, a company he co-founded to build what he describes as general biological intelligence.
members.name: Eric Nguyen

members.hook: Li made modern AI's breakthrough possible by betting on data before it was fashionable: ImageNet's fourteen million labeled images gave the field the benchmark on which AlexNet proved deep learning worked. She has spent the years since insisting the technology stay pointed at people, building Stanford HAI and carrying the human-centered case into policy rooms from Sacramento to Washington.
members.name: Fei-Fei Li

members.hook: Hinton kept faith with neural networks through two AI winters, and won. The training method he championed in 1986 and the 2012 breakthrough his lab produced turned a marginal idea into the technology behind modern AI. Then, at the peak of vindication, he quit Google to warn the world about what he had helped build, giving AI risk its most credentialed voice.
members.name: Geoffrey Hinton

members.hook: Reis-Filho built his career deciphering cancer genomics at the bench, at the Institute of Cancer Research and then as Chief of Experimental Pathology at Memorial Sloan Kettering, before moving to AstraZeneca to apply AI foundation models and agentic frameworks directly to drug discovery and clinical development, one of the clearer examples of a working oncologist becoming an enterprise AI leader.
members.name: Jorge Reis-Filho
members.moniker: Chief of AI for Science Innovation at AstraZeneca

members.hook: Gruber built a career in academic knowledge-representation research before co-founding Siri, whose acquisition by Apple in 2010 put conversational AI into hundreds of millions of pockets years before ChatGPT made the category mainstream, and he has argued ever since for AI designed to amplify human intelligence rather than substitute for it.
members.name: Tom Gruber

members.hook: Badrinarayanan helped write one of computer vision's most-cited deep learning papers, SegNet, before moving into frontier AI research at DeepMind, and now leads AI development at Wayve, applying end-to-end learned driving models rather than the hand-coded rule systems most autonomous vehicle companies rely on.
members.name: Vijay Badrinarayanan
members.moniker: Computer Vision Researcher Behind SegNet and Wayve's Self-Driving AI

members.hook: Ellsworth graduated early from Stanford with a B.S. in Computer Science with Distinction, worked as a research engineer at Google DeepMind, and now leads initiatives related to search and agents as a Member of Technical Staff at OpenAI. He was a U.S. Presidential Scholar and a USA Biology Olympiad national finalist.
members.name: Will Ellsworth
